# Ambient DS — AI Reference

## What This Is

A token-driven React component library. Every visual value (color, spacing, typography,
radius, shadow) is a CSS custom property derived from Figma. To customize the design system,
edit tokens in Figma → export JSON → run `npm run tokens:build`. No component code changes needed.

## Stack

- React 18 + TypeScript 5
- Tailwind CSS v4 (utility classes only, always with CSS variable values)
- class-variance-authority (CVA) for component variants
- Vite 5 + Storybook 10
- Font: Plus Jakarta Sans (variable font, 200–800 weight axis)

## Install in a Consumer Project

```bash
npm install github:YOUR_ORG/altir-ds
```

```tsx
// 1. Import token CSS — required, components render unstyled without this
import 'altir-ds/tokens/css'

// 2. Import components
import { Button, FloatingButton, TextField } from 'altir-ds'
```

## Token System

All CSS custom properties live in `src/tokens.generated.css` (auto-generated).
They are available globally after importing `src/global.css`.

### Naming Convention

```
--{collection}-{group}-{variant}
```

Examples:
- `--typography-size-label-medium`   → typography collection, size group, label-medium variant
- `--corner-radius-corner-full`      → shapes collection, corner-radius group, full variant
- `--spacing-space-16px`             → spacing collection, space group, 16px step
- `--inset-component-inset-component-md-x` → spacing collection, component inset, md size, x axis

### Token Collections

#### Colors — Semantic (use these in components)
```
--background-screen          page background
--background-elevated        card / modal background
--background-overlay         scrim behind modals (rgba)

--surface-primary            white surface
--surface-secondary          slightly tinted surface
--surface-tertiary           input / field background
--surface-disabled           disabled element background
--surface-accent             accent-tinted surface

--action-primary             primary button fill (black in light, white in dark)
--action-primary-inverse     text on primary button (white in light, black in dark)
--action-secondary           secondary action color
--action-disabled            disabled button fill
--action-distructive         destructive/negative action fill
--action-accent              accent action (blue)

--content-primary            body text
--content-secondary          secondary / label text
--content-disabled           disabled text
--content-primary-inverse    text on dark surfaces
--content-accent             accent text (blue)

--border-divider             subtle divider lines
--border-outline             input borders, card outlines
--border-action              active / focused border

--state-hover-overlay        white/black 20% overlay — use on dark/filled/colored backgrounds (FAB, filled checkbox, chips)
--state-pressed-overlay      white/black 32% overlay — use on dark/filled/colored backgrounds
--state-hover-fill           solid hover bg — use on light/empty backgrounds (list rows, secondary/ghost buttons, text fields, dropdown items)
--state-pressed-fill         solid pressed bg — use on light/empty backgrounds
--state-focus-ring           focus ring color (#068BEE)
--state-selected             selected row/item background


--sentiment-positive-background-strong / -light / -foreground / -border
--sentiment-warning-background-strong  / -light / -foreground / -border
--sentiment-negative-background-strong / -light / -foreground / -border
--sentiment-neutral-background-strong  / -light / -foreground / -border

--expression-blue-background-strong / -background-light / -foreground
--expression-magenta-background-strong / -background-light / -foreground
--expression-teal-background-strong / -background-light / -foreground
--expression-purple-background-strong / -background-light / -foreground
--expression-lime-background-strong / -background-light / -foreground
```

#### Colors — Primitive (use only in token definitions, not in components)
```
--colors-{name}{shade}   e.g. --colors-blue-500, --colors-cool-gray-100
```

#### Typography
```
--typography-font-family                  'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif

--typography-weight-display               700
--typography-weight-heading               700
--typography-weight-label                 600
--typography-weight-paragraph             400

--typography-size-display-large           96px
--typography-size-display-medium          64px
--typography-size-display-small           48px
--typography-size-heading-xxlarge         40px
--typography-size-heading-xlarge          36px
--typography-size-heading-large           32px
--typography-size-heading-medium          28px
--typography-size-heading-small           24px
--typography-size-heading-xsmall          20px
--typography-size-label-large             18px
--typography-size-label-medium            16px   ← default button label
--typography-size-label-small             14px
--typography-size-label-xsmall            12px
--typography-size-paragraph-large         18px
--typography-size-paragraph-medium        16px   ← default body / input
--typography-size-paragraph-small         14px
--typography-size-paragraph-xsmall        12px   ← helper text / captions

--typography-line-height-{scale}-{size}   matches every size token above
  e.g. --typography-line-height-label-medium    24px
       --typography-line-height-paragraph-xsmall 16px
```

#### Spacing
```
--spacing-space-2px    2px
--spacing-space-4px    4px
--spacing-space-8px    8px
--spacing-space-12px   12px
--spacing-space-16px   16px
--spacing-space-20px   20px
--spacing-space-24px   24px
--spacing-space-28px   28px
--spacing-space-32px   32px
--spacing-space-40px   40px
--spacing-space-48px   48px
--spacing-space-64px   64px
```

#### Component Insets (padding inside interactive components)
```
--inset-component-inset-component-sm-x   12px   (responsive: 8px tablet/mobile)
--inset-component-inset-component-sm-y    8px   (responsive: 4px tablet/mobile)
--inset-component-inset-component-md-x   16px   (responsive: 12px tablet/mobile)
--inset-component-inset-component-md-y   12px   (responsive: 8px tablet/mobile)
--inset-component-inset-component-lg-x   24px   (responsive: 16px tablet/mobile)
--inset-component-inset-component-lg-y   16px   (responsive: 12px tablet/mobile)
```

#### Gap
```
--gap-gap-related-tight      8px    tightly related siblings (icon + label, avatar + name)
--gap-gap-related-default    16px   standard related-element gap

--gap-gap-stack-tight        8px    vertical stack tight
--gap-gap-stack-default      16px   vertical stack default
--gap-gap-stack-loose        24px   vertical stack loose
--gap-gap-stack-section      64px   between page sections

--gap-gap-inline-tight       8px    tightly packed inline elements (tags, avatars)
--gap-gap-inline-default     12px   standard toolbar/nav gap
--gap-gap-inline-loose       16px   generous top-level nav gap
```

#### Shapes
```
--corner-radius-corner-none      0px
--corner-radius-corner-xsmall    2px
--corner-radius-corner-small     4px
--corner-radius-corner-medium    8px    ← default cards, inputs, buttons
--corner-radius-corner-large     12px
--corner-radius-corner-xlarge    16px
--corner-radius-corner-2xlarge   24px
--corner-radius-corner-full      999px  ← pills, FAB

--stroke-stroke-hairline         0.5px
--stroke-stroke-thin             1px
--stroke-stroke-medium           1.5px  ← secondary button border
--stroke-stroke-bold             2px    ← focus / error borders

--focus-focus-ring-width         2px
--focus-focus-ring-offset        2px
```

#### Elevation / Shadows
```
--shadow-shadow-soft     rgba(0,0,0,0.08)   shadow color, soft layer
--shadow-shadow-medium   rgba(0,0,0,0.12)   shadow color, medium layer
--shadow-shadow-strong   rgba(0,0,0,0.16)   shadow color, strong layer

Shadow utilities (defined in global.css, use as Tailwind class):
  shadow-elevation-small    subtle shadow (disabled state)
  shadow-elevation-medium   standard shadow (floating button)
```

#### Brand
```
--brand-brand-primary    #AACB42   brand green
--brand-brand-secondary  #7A7A7C   brand grey
```

---

## Components

### Button

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'

// Variants
<Button variant="primary">Save</Button>        // default — filled black
<Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>    // outlined, 1.5px border
<Button variant="ghost">Learn more</Button>    // text + underline
<Button variant="negative">Delete</Button>     // filled destructive red

// Sizes — all use label-medium (16px) typography; size affects padding only
<Button size="lg">Large</Button>   // inset-lg padding
<Button size="md">Medium</Button>  // inset-md padding (default)
<Button size="sm">Small</Button>   // inset-sm padding
<Button size="xs">X-Small</Button> // space-8px / space-4px padding

// States
<Button disabled>Unavailable</Button>
<Button isLoading>Saving…</Button>

// Icons
<Button leftIcon={<PlusIcon />}>Add item</Button>
<Button rightIcon={<ArrowRightIcon />}>Continue</Button>
```

Props:
| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `primary\|secondary\|ghost\|negative` | `primary` | |
| `size` | `lg\|md\|sm\|xs` | `md` | |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | `false` | shows spinner, disables button |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `leftIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | shown before children |
| `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | shown after children, hidden when loading |
| `className` | `string` | — | merged via cn() |
| `data-testid` | `string` | `'button'` | |
All native `<button>` attributes are forwarded. Supports `ref`.

### FloatingButton (FAB)

```tsx
import { FloatingButton } from '@/components/ui/floating-button'

// Default: lg size, plus icon, pill shape
<FloatingButton>New item</FloatingButton>

// Sizes
<FloatingButton size="lg">Create</FloatingButton>
<FloatingButton size="md">Add</FloatingButton>

// Custom icon
<FloatingButton icon={<EditIcon />}>Edit</FloatingButton>

// Icon-only (square aspect ratio)
<FloatingButton iconOnly icon={<PlusIcon />} />
<FloatingButton size="md" iconOnly />

// States
<FloatingButton disabled />
<FloatingButton isLoading />
```

Props:
| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | `lg\|md` | `lg` | |
| `iconOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | removes label, square pad |
| `icon` | `ReactNode` | `<PlusIcon />` | defaults to plus if omitted |
| `isLoading` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | drops to elevation-small |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `data-testid` | `string` | `'floating-button'` | |
Supports `ref`.

### TextField

```tsx
import { TextField } from '@/components/ui/text-field'

// Basic — floating label, no helper
<TextField label="Email" />

// With helper text
<TextField label="Password" helperText="Must be at least 8 characters" />

// Error state
<TextField label="Email" error helperText="Invalid email address" />

// Right icon
<TextField label="Search" rightIcon={<SearchIcon />} />

// Disabled
<TextField label="Username" disabled defaultValue="john_doe" />

// Controlled
<TextField
  label="Name"
  value={name}
  onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
/>
```

Props:
| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `label` | `string` | `'Label'` | floating label text |
| `helperText` | `string` | — | shown below field with icon |
| `error` | `boolean` | `false` | red border + red helper text |
| `rightIcon` | `ReactNode` | — | icon in right side of input |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `value` | `string` | — | controlled mode |
| `defaultValue` | `string` | — | uncontrolled mode |
| `className` | `string` | — | applied to outer wrapper |
| `data-testid` | `string` | `'text-field-input'` | on the `<input>` element |
All native `<input>` attributes except `size` are forwarded. Supports `ref`.

Border states (inset box-shadow, layout-stable):
- Empty: 1px `--border-outline`
- Filled: 1px `--border-outline`
- Focus: 2px `--action-primary`
- Error: 2px `--sentiment-negative-border`
- Disabled: 1px `--border-outline`

---

## Rules for AI Builders

### Always

1. Import tokens CSS before using any component:
   ```tsx
   import 'altir-ds/tokens/css'   // in a consumer app
   // or in this repo: src/global.css is already imported in Storybook
   ```

2. Use CSS variables for **every** visual value — color, spacing, size, radius, shadow:
   ```tsx
   // ✅ correct
   className="px-[var(--spacing-space-16px)] text-[color:var(--content-primary)]"
   className="rounded-[var(--corner-radius-corner-medium)]"

   // ❌ wrong
   className="px-4 text-gray-900 rounded-md"
   ```

3. Use explicit Tailwind arbitrary property syntax for font properties:
   ```tsx
   // ✅ correct — unambiguous
   '[font-weight:var(--typography-weight-label)]'
   '[font-family:var(--typography-font-family)]'
   'text-[length:var(--typography-size-label-medium)]'
   'leading-[var(--typography-line-height-label-medium)]'

   // ❌ wrong — font-[var(...)] is ambiguous in Tailwind v4, may resolve as font-family
   'font-[var(--typography-weight-label)]'
   'font-semibold'
   'text-sm'
   ```

4. Use semantic color tokens (not primitive `--colors-*`):
   ```tsx
   // ✅ correct
   'bg-[var(--surface-tertiary)]'
   'text-[color:var(--content-primary)]'

   // ❌ wrong — primitives are not themeable
   'bg-[var(--colors-cool-gray-100)]'
   '#F3F5F9'
   ```

5. Use inset box-shadow for borders on components whose height must stay stable:
   ```css
   /* ✅ inset shadow — doesn't affect layout */
   box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--stroke-stroke-thin) var(--border-outline);

   /* ❌ border-width pushes siblings when it changes */
   border: 1px solid var(--border-outline);
   ```

6. Define named utilities in `global.css @layer utilities` for any class Tailwind's
   static scanner can't detect (conditional ternaries, template literals):
   ```css
   @layer utilities {
     .my-border-active {
       box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--stroke-stroke-bold) var(--action-primary);
     }
   }
   ```

### Never

- Hardcode any color hex, rgba, or named color (`text-white`, `bg-black`)
- Use plain Tailwind scale utilities: `p-4`, `text-sm`, `font-bold`, `rounded-lg`, `shadow-md`
- Use `font-[var(...)]` — it's ambiguous; use `[font-weight:var(...)]` instead
- Use `--colors-*` primitives directly in components
- Invent values for missing tokens — report them instead

### If a Token Is Missing

Report it clearly:
> "No `--duration-*` token exists. Need `--duration-fast` (100ms) and `--duration-default` (150ms)
> added to a Motion collection in Figma."

Do not use hardcoded fallbacks silently.

---

## Adding a New Component

Follow this pattern exactly:

```tsx
// src/components/ui/my-component.tsx
import { forwardRef } from 'react'
import { cva, type VariantProps } from 'class-variance-authority'
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils'

const myComponentVariants = cva(
  [
    // Base classes — all token-based
    '[font-family:var(--typography-font-family)]',
    '[font-weight:var(--typography-weight-label)]',
    'rounded-[var(--corner-radius-corner-medium)]',
    'transition-colors duration-150',   // duration-150: no token yet, flag it
    // Focus ring — always include for accessibility
    'focus-visible:outline-none',
    'focus-visible:ring-[length:var(--focus-focus-ring-width)]',
    'focus-visible:ring-[var(--state-focus-ring)]',
    'focus-visible:ring-offset-[var(--focus-focus-ring-offset)]',
  ],
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: ['bg-[var(--surface-primary)]', 'text-[color:var(--content-primary)]'],
      },
      size: {
        md: [
          'px-[var(--inset-component-inset-component-md-x)]',
          'py-[var(--inset-component-inset-component-md-y)]',
          'text-[length:var(--typography-size-label-medium)]',
          'leading-[var(--typography-line-height-label-medium)]',
        ],
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: { variant: 'default', size: 'md' },
  }
)

export interface MyComponentProps
  extends React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>,
    VariantProps<typeof myComponentVariants> {}

const MyComponent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, MyComponentProps>(
  ({ className, variant, size, ...props }, ref) => (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className={cn(myComponentVariants({ variant, size }), className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
)

MyComponent.displayName = 'MyComponent'
export { MyComponent }
```

Add a story at `src/stories/my-component.stories.tsx`.

---

## Dark Mode

Apply `data-theme="dark"` or class `dark` to any ancestor element.
All semantic tokens (`--action-*`, `--content-*`, `--surface-*`, etc.) automatically switch.
No component code changes needed — dark mode is fully token-driven.

```tsx
<div data-theme="dark">
  <Button variant="primary">Looks correct in dark mode</Button>
</div>
```

---

## Responsive Tokens

Spacing and grid tokens automatically adjust at breakpoints via CSS media queries
in `src/tokens.generated.css`. Components using `--inset-component-*` and
`--spacing-space-*` are responsive by default — no Tailwind breakpoint prefixes needed
for standard padding/gaps.

- Desktop: ≥ 1024px (base values)
- Tablet:  ≤ 1024px (`@media (max-width: 1024px)`)
- Mobile:  ≤ 768px  (`@media (max-width: 768px)`)

---

## Customizing the Design System

1. Open Figma → Variables panel
2. Edit token values (colors, sizes, spacing, etc.)
3. Export updated JSON files to `tokens/figma/`
4. Run `npm run tokens:build`
5. `src/tokens.generated.css` is regenerated — all components update automatically

Token collections in Figma:
- `primitives` → raw color palette (never use directly)
- `colors` → semantic light + dark color roles
- `typography` → font-family, weight, size, line-height
- `spacing` → space scale + component insets + gaps
- `shapes` → corner radius + stroke widths + focus ring
- `elevation` → shadow values (light + dark)
- `layout` → grid (margin, gutter, columns), workspace, canvas dimensions per breakpoint
  CSS vars: --layout-grid-margin, --layout-grid-gutter, --layout-grid-columns
            --layout-workspace-width, --layout-canvas-max-width, --layout-show-sidebar

---

## Project Structure

```
src/
  components/ui/     ← components (one file per component, lowercase)
  stories/           ← Storybook stories (one per component)
  fonts/             ← Plus Jakarta Sans variable font files
  lib/utils.ts       ← cn() = clsx + tailwind-merge
  global.css         ← Tailwind entry, @font-face, token import, named utilities
  tokens.generated.css ← AUTO-GENERATED — do not edit manually
  tokens.metadata.json ← AUTO-GENERATED — token descriptions, aiGroup, aiImpact per CSS var

tokens/
  build.js           ← converts tokens/figma/**/*.json → tokens.generated.css + tokens.metadata.json
  figma/             ← Figma export source files (never edit manually)
    primitives.json
    colors/light.json + dark.json
    elevation/light.json + dark.json
    shapes/shapes.json
    typography/desktop.json + tablet.json + mobile.json
    spacing/desktop.json + tablet.json + mobile.json
    layout/desktop.json + tablet.json + mobile.json

.storybook/
  main.ts            ← Storybook config with Tailwind v4 plugin
  preview.ts         ← imports global.css for Storybook
```
